categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Interact Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in intelligent finance, intelligent security, and intelligent commerce sectors. It provides digital transformation technology services to financial institutions, government departments, and commercial groups, focusing on smart banking systems, security platforms for public safety, and smart solutions for hotels, marketing, and budget management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence (AI), blockchain, microservices architecture, distributed systems, multimodal AI, and intelligent agents. It develops proprietary digital banking systems, AI-driven risk control, security gateways, next-generation firewalls, and multi-cloud management platforms, emphasizing AI integration and domestic product adaptation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major banks (including the Big Four and joint-stock banks), insurance companies, government public security departments, high-end hotels, and large enterprises across manufacturing, commerce, and fast-moving consumer goods sectors. The company serves primarily the financial, government/public service, and commercial industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Beijing and subsidiaries in Shanghai, Guangzhou, Jinan, Chengdu, Taiyuan, Wuhan, Hangzhou, and Hong Kong. Its revenue is concentrated in North China and East China regions, with minor overseas operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the IT and digital transformation supply chain, providing software development, system integration, and technology services. It acts as a technology solution provider and service integrator rather than a hardware manufacturer or end-user.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening AI technology integration with industry scenarios, focusing on multi-modal fusion, intelligent agents, and generative AI. The company invests heavily in R&D to enhance AI capabilities, collaborates with universities and research institutions, and emphasizes AI+hardware-software integrated solutions, especially in finance, security, and commerce.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through IT system solution sales and technology service contracts, including software development, system integration, and digital transformation services. The company also earns income from hotel and home media services and some rental income from investment properties. Sales are predominantly direct.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a leading digital transformation technology service provider with strong AI-driven innovation, deep vertical industry expertise, and robust ecosystem partnerships with major domestic players like Huawei and Inspur. It holds multiple national certifications and industry awards, enhancing its competitive standing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 425 million, a 22.27% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 3.21 million, improving significantly from a larger loss in 2023. The company has a total asset base of around RMB 758 million and continues to invest heavily in R&D, representing over 11% of revenue, indicating a focus on future growth despite recent financial challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes AI-driven full-stack technology capabilities, proprietary digital transformation architectures, and strong domestic product adaptation. It offers customized, scenario-based solutions with high security and compliance standards, supported by extensive industry experience and strategic partnerships. Its unique value lies in integrating AI innovations with vertical industry needs to enhance operational efficiency, security, and customer experience.
